main.description: Post a comment on a node (document or comment). Requires a session, and membership of the node's context; the caller's DID is the comment's author.

on_id.description: The node the comment replies to.

context_id.description: Optional, and only checked: a comment's context is always the one its node is in.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: No such node, or none the caller may read.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller may read the node but is not a member of its context.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: `context_id` names a context the node is not in.
